title: Wave Walker Charters

services.name: Wave Walker Charters
services.desc: Wave Walker Charters specializes in deep water trolling for trophy walleye and steelhead trout out of Cleveland, Ohio. Lake Erie is worldwide renowned for its walleye fishery and is often referred to as the "Walleye Capital of the World. The deep waters of the central basin of Lake Erie provide great opportunities to troll for trophy sized walleye. The area from just west of Cleveland all they way to Buffalo New York is also known as "Steelhead Alley" providing many opportunities to catch trophy sized steelhead as well.
